# Filter out QA orders
# Create a mask for QA orders
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Filter the full dataset to exclude QA orders and refunded orders
# Then extract completed orders
cleaned_df = df[~qa_mask]
completed_cleaned_df = cleaned_df[cleaned_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Now parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
completed_cleaned_df['revenue_float'] = completed_cleaned_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Compute mean revenue for completed orders after removing QA orders
mean_revenue_completed_cleaned = completed_cleaned_df['revenue_float'].mean()

print(f"Mean revenue after removing QA orders: {mean_revenue_completed_cleaned}")"}
